title: 第332章 大闹段家第331章 柳如烟受伤
slug: 黑化后我称霸三千大世界
lines: 随着段家指令一出，令所有的圣地都感到无比的屈辱，不管怎么说他们都是传承上万年的圣地，什么时候受过这样的屈辱
关键是他们还无法去反抗
在整个幽芒大陆中，势力的大概分为凡间世家，修仙朝廷，大宗，圣地，最后就是传承十万年以上的顶级修仙大族
而段家就是传承了十万年之久的顶级修仙大族，在修仙大族面前，他们这些圣地根本无法反抗
只能遵从段家的指令行事，并将圣地圣女送给段家少主段天
在幽芒大陆的另一边
柳如烟飞了近半月终于飞出了冰河海域，并在途中斩杀了不少冰河海域的海兽，中间还一边练习自身的神通
幽域
这是柳如烟在赶路的时候无意觉醒的一门神通，在幽域之内，她可以掌握幽域内的一切天地之力，一旦她突破到仙帝
幽域中的天地之力将自动转化为法则之力，在幽域内柳如烟就是无上的存在
“经过十日的练习，对于幽域的掌握已经越来越熟悉了，红尘仙内我无敌！”
此时的柳如烟已经可以清晰的感受到自身的实力越来越醇厚，甚至可以达到如挥臂一般自在
“如今已经准备好了，就不需要再浪费时间了，得赶紧灭掉段家，不然本姑娘道心不稳”
想到不久之前段家为了抓自己，封锁了整个冰河海域，这就让她感到无比的憋屈，这个账必须要算
咻！
接着柳如烟就化作一道流光飞向段家
而此时的段家，张灯结彩，各种吹箫唢呐非常的喜庆，虚空上还有几百座山峰传出兽鸣，并且还有无数飞舟停留在段家外门之地
段家作为幽芒大陆顶级大族之一，所占的领地范围达到了五十里，并且这还不是外门核心区的领地范围
而在外门之地甚至还有不少势力前来拜贺，有的是想看看这个顶级修仙大族的段家究竟多大的本事
有的是想通过这个机会来巴结成为段家的附庸势力，只要攀附上来段家，他们这些人的地位就会水涨船高
“恭喜啊哈哈哈”
在段家大门外不断有其它势力来拜访，其中最差的也是大宗，最高的就是与段家齐名的吴家，郭家
幽芒大陆的顶级修仙大族只有三家，分别是西洲吴家，北州郭家，东州段家，至于南洲乃是荒芜之地，一般都是其它势力弟子历练之地
“不错嘛，这么热闹”
柳如烟来到段家的外门大门处看着人山人海的场景，同时还想起了在地球的时候豪门晚宴时的场景
“比地球的那些晚宴气派多了，就是可惜了，这里马上就要变成飞灰了”
柳如烟感受四周灵气环绕，这里的灵气浓度比她赶来路上时的还要浓厚，并且随处可见的还有阵法
攻阵，防御阵，幻阵，聚灵阵，大门外的两座龙像上还刻着不同的阵法，分别是杀阵与防御阵
“不知这位仙子可有邀请函？”
当柳如烟还在四处打量着段家环境的时候，一位段家外门弟子伸手拦住了柳如烟并询问有没有邀请函
“邀请函？没有”
柳如烟看着拦住自己的段家弟子，同时目光也放在了对方手中的邀请函，这些邀请函每一封都有一种势力的图标
“没有，可不能进入，还请仙子从哪来回哪去”
见面前的柳如烟并没有邀请函，段家弟子便让柳如烟就地离开
“可是我也不能走唉，我是来屠杀你们段家的哦”
柳如烟闻言嘴角上扬笑着道，瞳孔内闪过一道幽寒之力直接洞穿了面前段家弟子的精神识海
下一秒，段家弟子就直接倒在地上，死不瞑目
content_en:
As soon as the Duan family's order came out, all the holy places felt extremely humiliated. In any case, they were holy places that had been inherited for tens of thousands of years. When had they ever suffered such humiliation?
The key is that they can't resist yet
In the entire Youmang Continent, the forces are roughly divided into mortal families, immortal cultivating courts, large sects, holy lands, and finally the top immortal cultivating clans that have been inherited for more than 100,000 years.
The Duan family is a top-notch cultivating clan that has been inherited for 100,000 years. In front of the cultivating clan, these holy places cannot resist at all.
He can only act according to the instructions of the Duan family and give the Holy Land Saint to Duan Tian, the young master of the Duan family.
On the other side of Youmang Continent
Liu Ruyan flew for nearly half a month and finally flew out of the glacial sea. On the way, he killed many sea beasts in the glacial sea, while practicing his magical powers.
netherworld
This is a magical power that Liu Ruyan accidentally awakened while on the road. In the Nether Realm, she can control all the power of heaven and earth in the Nether Realm. Once she breaks through to the Immortal Emperor
The power of heaven and earth in the Nether Realm will automatically be converted into the power of law. Liu Ruyan is the supreme existence in the Nether Realm.
"After ten days of practice, I have become more and more familiar with the control of the Nether Realm. I am invincible in the Red Dust Immortal!"
At this time, Liu Ruyan could clearly feel that her strength was becoming more and more mellow, and she could even reach the point where she could feel as comfortable as waving her arms.
"Now that we are ready, there is no need to waste any more time. We must quickly destroy the Duan family, otherwise this girl will not be stable."
Thinking of the Duan family's blockade of the entire glacier sea not long ago in order to catch her, she felt extremely aggrieved. This account must be settled.
Phew!
Then Liu Ruyan turned into a stream of light and flew towards the Duan family
At this time, the Duan family was decorated with lanterns and colorful decorations, and various flutes and suonas were played in a very festive atmosphere. There were hundreds of peaks in the sky where the sounds of beasts were heard, and there were countless flying boats staying at the outer gate of the Duan family.
As one of the top families in Youmang Continent, the Duan family occupies a territory of fifty miles, and this is not the territory of the core area of ​​the outer gate.
There are even many forces in the outer sect who come to congratulate them. Some of them want to see how capable the Duan family, the top immortal cultivating clan, is.
Some want to use this opportunity to curry favor with the Duan family and become vassal forces. As long as they join the Duan family, their status will rise.
"Congratulations hahaha"
Outside the gate of the Duan family, other forces are constantly coming to visit. The worst among them is also the big sect, and the highest is the Wu family, which is as famous as the Duan family, and the Guo family.
There are only three top immortal cultivating families in Youmang Continent, namely the Wu family in Xizhou, the Guo family in Beizhou, and the Duan family in Dongzhou. As for Nanzhou, it is a desolate land and is generally a training ground for disciples from other forces.
"Not bad, so lively"
Liu Ruyan came to the outer gate of the Duan family and looked at the scene of huge crowds of people. At the same time, she also remembered the scene at the wealthy dinner party on Earth.
"It's much more elegant than those dinner parties on Earth, but it's a pity that this place will soon turn into ashes."
Liu Ruyan felt the spiritual energy surrounding her. The concentration of spiritual energy here was thicker than when she came here, and there were formations everywhere.
Attack formation, defense formation, illusion formation, spirit gathering formation, the two dragon statues outside the gate are also engraved with different formations, namely the killing formation and the defense formation.
"I wonder if this fairy has an invitation letter?"
When Liu Ruyan was still looking around at the Duan family's environment, an outer disciple of the Duan family reached out to stop Liu Ruyan and asked if there was an invitation letter.
"Invitation letter? No"
Liu Ruyan looked at the Duan family disciple who stopped him, and at the same time his eyes were focused on the invitation letters in his hands. Each of these invitation letters had a symbol of a certain power.
"No, you can't enter. Please ask the fairy to go back and forth from there."
There was no invitation letter for Liu Ruyan before the meeting, so the Duan family disciple asked Liu Ruyan to leave on the spot.
"But I can't leave either. I'm here to massacre your Duan family."
Hearing this, Liu Ruyan raised the corners of her mouth and said with a smile, a cold force flashed in her pupils and directly penetrated the spiritual consciousness of the Duan family disciple in front of her.
The next second, the Duan family disciple fell directly to the ground and died with his eyes open.
title_en: Chapter 332: Making trouble in the Duan family Chapter 331: Liu Ruyan is injured
